limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter handshake but also removed the `ready_b` condition from the accumulator's first-value load, changing `data_out` when a new group starts while downstream is not ready.

The scoreboard assumed every group starts from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so it exercised downstream stalls but validated the changed behavior rather than checking that the original accumulator behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before the test could compile or run, forcing a retry.
